profile.summary: fdegiuli demonstrates mid-level JavaScript expertise primarily through contributions to Lodash, a core utility library. Their work focuses on functional programming patterns such as chaining, immutability, and utility function composition. While contributions are limited to Lodash's core functionality, the PRs indicate a strong understanding of utility-first JavaScript development, functional paradigms, and maintainable code practices. There is no direct evidence of framework-specific (React/Vue/Angular) or backend (Node.js/Express) work, though Lodash's nature suggests familiarity with both ecosystems. The developer shows attention to code quality, edge-case handling, and API usability improvements, which are hallmarks of a mid-level JavaScript engineer.
